content.what_it_is: TIME_SPECTRA_MODULE implements a time-dependent spectral wavemaker (L46-L67): initialization reads the spectrum schedule, frequencies, directions, optional phases, and first amplitude matrix and allocates harmonic coefficient fields (L108-L271); protection requires tide generating/absorbing DATA boundary settings (L274-L314); interpolation advances schedule records and amplitude matrices and calls coefficient reconstruction (L316-L405); CALCULATE_DATA2D_Cm_Sm_TIME solves the dispersion relation once, constructs periodic directions once, and rebuilds spatial cosine/sine elevation and velocity coefficients for every frequency, direction, and local cell (L407-L535).
entities: module characters NameSpectra1, NameSpectra2, FILE_NAME, SPECTRA_FILE @L93-L95
TIME_SPECTRA_INITIAL locals Ifile, ierr, SpectraName, WHAT @L117-L119
TIME_SPECTRA_INTERPOLATION locals Ifile, ierr, I, J, rII, rJJ, IOstatus @L320-L322
CALCULATE_DATA2D_Cm_Sm_TIME locals Iter, KK, K, KKK, Celerity, Wave_Length, Fk, Fkdif, Zlev, Fact, X_maker, Y_maker, tmp_eta, tmp_u, tmp_v, Theta_Per @L410-L415

params_defined.name: PHASE_DATA
params_defined.range: 1 reads phases; other values generate random phases

params_defined.name: Fact
params_defined.range: assigned but not subsequently used in this routine

equations.ref: spatial cosine elevation coefficient, expanded at L497-L499

io.name: schedule title, bin counts, frequency bins, direction bins, phase flag/phases, initial time and amplitude filename
configuration and schedule diagnostics on units * and 3

verbatim_spans.text: !  mod_time_spectra.F is a wavemaker module for time-dependent spectra

unresolved: The direction initialization loops over frequency index KK and direction index KKK (L444-L453) but writes Theta_2D(I,KKK), not Theta_2D(KK,KKK), in both branches (L448, L450). I is a host-associated/global loop variable rather than the active frequency index, so one row may be repeatedly overwritten or the write may be out of bounds, while reconstruction later reads Theta_2D(KK,KKK) for every KK (L497-L526).

Initialization allocates AmpData1 but reads only AmpData2 and copies the time/name, not the amplitude matrix (L176-L181, L243-L264). In interpolation tmp1 and tmp2 start at zero and remain zero when TIME is equal to or earlier than the first timestamp (L362-L375); L377 then multiplies the uninitialized AmpData1 by zero and also zeroes AmpData2, yielding zero or undefined Amp_Ser at that boundary.

At schedule EOF the routine first advances TimeSpectra1 and AmpData1 to the last loaded record (L325-L329), then an EOF on the next time read jumps directly to label 120 (L333-L335, L379), bypassing L361-L377. Amp_Ser therefore remains the previous pre-EOF interpolation rather than being explicitly set to the final AmpData1, and subsequent calls repeat the same EOF jump.
